sn11.9:1.2: bhūtapubbaṃ bhikkhave sambahulā isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā araññāyatane paṇṇakuṭīsu sammanti.
sn11.9:1.3: atha kho bhikkhave sakko ca devānamindo vepacitti ca asurindo yena te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu.
sn11.9:1.4: atha kho bhikkhave vepacitti asurindo aṭaliyo upāhanā ārohitvā khaggaṃ olaggetvā chattena dhāriyamānena aggadvārena assamaṃ pavisitvā te isayo sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme apabyāmato karitvā atikkami.
sn11.9:1.5: atha kho bhikkhave sakko devānamindo aṭaliyo upāhanā orohitvā khaggaṃ aññesaṃ datvā chattaṃ apaṇāmetvā dvāreneva assamaṃ pavisitvā te isayo sīlavante kalyāṇadhamme anuvātaṃ pañjaliko namassamāno aṭṭhāsi.
sn11.9:1.6: atha kho bhikkhave te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā sakkaṃ devānamindaṃ gāthāya ajjhabhāsiṃsu
